text:
Nora Patel: Quick follow-up from the console review: we need a clear pattern for compact controls, toast anchoring, and hit areas before RC. Thoughts?
Derek Shaw: Saw the issue in the narrow layouttoasts overlapping the left action rail. I think toasts should anchor beneath pinned toolbars by default.
Elena Morales: Agree. Proposal: token `--toast-anchor-top` that teams can compose from `--pinned-toolbar-height`. Default: `calc(var(--pinned-toolbar-height) + 12px)`.
Marta Ruiz: Also controls: icon-only buttons in compact rows need smaller visual size but preserved hit area. Pattern: visual 16px, hit area 44px. Document it in tokens.
Nora Patel: Good. Micro-copy: change terse toasts like "Saved" to context-aware ones: "Dashboard saved  changes applied". Add i18n key.
Derek Shaw: Accessibility: when a modal is open toasts must be inert unless they are critical and explicitly promoted with `data-toast-priority="high"`. Default toasts get `aria-hidden=true` when overlay present.
Elena Morales: Also add behavior for actionable toasts encountered while a modal is open: instead of floating above, mount them into the modal header slot to keep context. Fallback to high-priority promotion.
Marta Ruiz: I'll add tokens: `--compact-gap: 6px`, `--compact-icon-size: 16px`, `--icon-hit-area: 44px`, `--toast-anchor-top: calc(var(--pinned-toolbar-height) + 12px)`.
Derek Shaw: Small CSS snippet for the PR: 
```
.icon--compact { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.icon--compact__hit { padding: calc((44px - 16px) / 2); }
.toast { top: var(--toast-anchor-top); }
.surface--modal .toast:not([data-toast-priority="high"]) { aria-hidden: true; }
```
Elena Morales: QA found two stories with icon-only buttons missing `aria-label`. We'll add a lint rule to block merges. design-bot: can you create the draft tokens file?
design-bot: Draft created: design/tokens/compact-controls.yml (preview)
Nora Patel: Action items: Marta add tokens + docs, Derek add CSS + visual test for anchored toasts, Elena add lint for aria-labels and update modal-docs with toast-in-header pattern. Target next patch. :white_check_mark:
Marta Ruiz: I'll also add sample markup for promoting a toast: `<div class=\"toast\" data-toast-priority=\"high\">` and examples for mounting to modal header.
